description: Behavioral cases for read-only review. The mode-boundary case is the load-bearing one: a review that rewrites is not a review.

evals.prompt: Review this draft and leave the file untouched: "Our new process is transformative. It unlocks collaboration across teams and underscores the importance of alignment."
evals.expected_output: Lead with a piece-level diagnosis, locate the unsupported abstractions, and ask for the missing mechanism. No replacement draft.

assertions.name: piece-level-diagnosis-first
assertions.check: The response opens with a piece-level assessment (job, substance, trust, development, voice, ending, or top fixes) rather than jumping straight to line edits

assertions.name: no-replacement-draft
assertions.check: The response does not supply a rewritten version of the passage

assertions.name: verdicts-used
assertions.check: Findings use the keep / revise / ask-author / cut vocabulary

assertions.name: no-file-write-claim
assertions.check: The response does not claim to have edited, saved, or staged a file

evals.prompt: Review this: "A dependency made us vulnerable last year and it cost us. We fixed it."
evals.expected_output: The passage is fixable but needs facts only the author has, so the verdict is ask-author with a specific question.

assertions.name: ask-author-verdict
assertions.check: At least one finding carries the ask-author verdict rather than revise or cut

assertions.name: specific-question-asked
assertions.check: The response asks for the specific missing detail (which package, what month, how it was caught) rather than a generic request to add detail

assertions.name: no-invented-detail
assertions.check: The response does not invent a package name, date, cost, or incident

evals.prompt: Review this closing: "I have a 327-name scored lead tracker. Three emails sent. One reply. Zero closes."
evals.expected_output: The three-beat landing is protected, not flagged as a fragment problem.

assertions.name: landing-not-flagged
assertions.check: The short closing sequence is not reported as a defect, a fragment problem, or something to merge

assertions.name: keep-verdict-or-silence
assertions.check: If the passage is mentioned at all, it carries a keep verdict with the reason it is earned

evals.prompt: Review this: "The build finished in 40 minutes. We shipped it the same day, and the pulse check caught the silent failure before the next stage ran."
evals.expected_output: If the prose already does its job, say so plainly rather than manufacturing findings.

assertions.name: no-manufactured-findings
assertions.check: The response does not invent weaknesses in order to appear useful

assertions.name: clean-verdict-allowed
assertions.check: Reporting the piece as ready is an acceptable output
